title: Crispy Brazilian Bowl
description: A savory and crunchy Brazilian-inspired bowl with crispy umami bits.

ingredients.name: Roasted Pickle
ingredients.notes: Slice a dill pickle, toss with olive oil, salt, and roast at 400°F for 10 minutes

instructions: Toss the pickle slices with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt, and a pinch of black pepper.
Roast the pickles in the oven for 10 minutes or until slightly tender.
In a large ceramic bowl, combine the cooked Brazilian rice, crispy umami bits, and roasted pickles.
